$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md). Targets are public, well-known hosts.

tasks.name: domain-whois-dns-ssl-lookup
tasks.title: Domain lookup: WHOIS, DNS records and SSL certificate at once
tasks.description: Look up a domain's WHOIS registration (registrar, dates, name servers), its DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS) and its SSL certificate in one run, with a confidence score per source. Replace github.com with the domain you are checking.
tasks.seoTitle: Domain Lookup - WHOIS, DNS Records and SSL Check
tasks.seoDescription: WHOIS registration, DNS records (A, MX, TXT, NS) and the SSL certificate of a domain in one run, each with a confidence score. Bulk-ready.

tasks.name: ip-address-lookup-location-owner
tasks.title: IP address lookup: location, owner and reputation of an IP
tasks.description: Look up an IP address's geolocation (country, city, ISP, ASN), its WHOIS owner and its reputation on blocklists in one run. Works for IPv4 and IPv6; switch on batch mode to check a list.
tasks.seoTitle: IP Address Lookup - Location, Owner and Reputation
tasks.seoDescription: Geolocation, ISP, ASN, WHOIS owner and blocklist reputation of an IP address in one run. IPv4 and IPv6, single or in bulk.
